bear_assumptions: Fiscal-2027 revenue reaches the USD 5.9911 billion guidance floor, normalized free-cash-flow margin is 27%, and 45x FCF plus USD 4.2676 billion simple net cash is divided by 1.07 billion diluted shares; growth and cash conversion slow while acquisition, incident and equity costs persist.
base_assumptions: Fiscal-2027 revenue reaches the USD 6.0011 billion guidance midpoint, normalized free-cash-flow margin is 31%, and 60x FCF plus USD 4.2676 billion simple net cash is divided by 1.055 billion diluted shares; raised guidance is met, platform adoption remains durable, and dilution moderates only gradually.
bull_assumptions: Fiscal-2027 revenue reaches the USD 6.0111 billion guidance ceiling, normalized free-cash-flow margin is 34%, and 75x FCF plus USD 4.2676 billion simple net cash is divided by 1.04 billion diluted shares; high-end growth and cash conversion persist while incident, acquisition and dilution costs ease.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh scenario set clears expected-return, base-upside, downside-payoff and margin-of-safety gates at the then-current price while ARR, retention, paid module adoption, GAAP economics and per-share cash conversion remain sound; downgrade the operating thesis if renewal quality, trust, competitive position or cash conversion deteriorates.
